### Solid

A clean, unbroken horizontal rule. Default style. Use for separating major sections.

### Dashed

A series of short dashes. Creates a lighter visual break — good for sub-section dividers.

### Double

Two parallel lines stacked closely together. Adds a more formal or structured feel.

### Decorative

A typographic ornament — uses the `— ✦ —` symbol. Adds a stylish, editorial touch to newspaper-style layouts.

---

**Usage tip:** All divider styles accept a `margin_mm` property (default 3) to control the vertical space above and below the rule.
